name: mini-me-portable
description: A local personal adviser that keeps owner choices and evidence under the owner's control.

interface.longDescription: Consult a locally stored personal profile through a shared MCP server, CLI, or library. Predictions are advisory and owner records remain local.
interface.defaultPrompt: Consult Mini Me only for the relevant scope, cite evidence and uncertainty, and ask the owner before learning from new material or recording a real outcome.
